profile.headline: Office/Practice Manager At Thriving Dermatology Practice

positions.title: Office/Practice Manager
positions.description: Skills: Human Resources (HR) · Patient Satisfaction · Information Technology · Recruiting · Workflow Management · People Management

company.name: Dermatology and Skin Care of Maryland

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
•	Led implementation of identity management solution for the client’s Membership Application that provided authentication and authorization to various components of the application. Application was developed using C# and MVC while leveraging Windows Identity Foundation and Active Directory Federation Services 3.0.
•	Developed Admin Registration System used to manage over 1,500 students who attended the client’s annual Instructor Training Program. Responsible for both front (UI) and back end development. This multi-tiered application was developed using C# (MVC), Entity Framework, Knockoutjs, jQuery, JavaScript, Ajax, and Bootstrap. A MVVM design pattern was employed to bind all data to the UI. This architecture, combined with the array of technologies, provided a fluid user experience.
•	Developed a custom Security Token Service web application in C# allowing users external to the client’s domain to authenticate against Active Directory Lightweight Directory Services. The STS was integrated with a Relying Party application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed an automated billing system using SQL Server 2000 and VB.NET to invoice and debit merchants for their monthly ACH payment processing use. This upgrade replaced a manual process in which all fees were calculated by hand and a statement was subsequently mailed to merchants. Invoices were made available online to provide a detailed accounting of payment processing fees. 
•	Created a console application using VB.NET and SQL Server 2008 to process flat files containing rejected ACH payments. Utilized SSIS for ETL of a flat file originating from partner bank. Programmatically implemented business rules pertaining to the nature and handling of each rejected payment. This component was developed in combination with a custom windows service that would detect files being added to a Windows Server 2003 file system. 
•	Converted and redesigned a merchant management utility from ASP to VB.NET using SQL Server 2008 as the RDBMS. Converted inline TSQL to stored procedures and added triggers to enforce predefined business rules. 
•	Identified underperforming TSQL queries by utilizing traces and analyzing execution plans. Tuned queries by modifying TSQL, denormalizing data, and adding appropriate table indexes. 
•	Designed, built, and maintained an online Merchant Application using ASP, HTML, JavaScript, and SQL Server 2000 allowing businesses to enroll for and gain immediate access to Pathfinder’s Payment Gateway for processing credit card and ACH payments. Using an API, seamlessly incorporated identity verification using a third party vendor for risk management. The online enrollment allowed Pathfinder to augment their merchant portfolio while substantially increasing revenue, streamlining business processes, reducing overhead, and mitigating risk.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Created a fully automated, database driven data feed of client’s products to be sold online via Froogle 
Troubleshot and restored functionality to a shopping cart enabling online gift card purchases.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Integrated desktop software used by property management companies with Ocius' payment gateway as a means for property management companies to augment their own systems in order to reduce unit vacancy. 

Designed numerous web interfaces, including credit card registration for apartment tenants to pay their rent, thereby allowing property management companies to improve their overall rate of collections.

Developed an online report enabling Ocius and their clients to reconcile and manage all online credit card and ACH transactions for tracking monthly rental payments. 

Administration and development of SQL Server 2000 database including stored procedures, triggers, DDL/DML; assessed performance of and tuned databases utlizing traces, query optimization, and table indexing. Implement disaster recovery plan including backups of SQL Server, web site files, and system state. 

Created scheduled and alert based e-mail notifications for clients;  developed VBA application used to interface with Microsoft Excel for reporting the company’s bank  account activity.

Technologies used: Visual Basic/COM, ASP, SQL Server 2000, JavaScript, HTML

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Developed a web site for collecting data to enable small business owners to compare their insurance 
premiums and coverage against those in similar industries and geographical areas using VB, ASP, and SQL Server 7.
Co developed multi-tiered application for a downloadable screensaver company.
Defined site functionality, business processes, and reported on project progress to clients
